    HOW TO PLAY

    The one idea

    Break a hole in the field and punch the ball above the bricks. While any ball is up there the overdrive meter charges by itself — every brick it clips on the way pays at your current multiplier.

    Tiers

    ×2 LIFT → ×3 SURGE → ×5 OVERDRIVE → ×8 SUPERNOVA. Sustained roof rides fire cascade pulses and accelerate your balls. Dip below and stored heat keeps the reward alive briefly, then the meter cools.

    Paddle

    It moves up and down inside the bottom zone. Strike while rising: the launch adds up to +32% ball speed. This is how you crack speed gates and steer into steep hits.

    Bricks

    • Standard — one clean hit.
    • Angular gate ⌃ — reflects unless the hit is steep (|vy| ≥ 62% of speed). Come from below, steep.
    • Speed gate » — reflects unless the ball is fast (800+ px/s). Ramp speed with paddle lifts.
    • Steel — never breaks; use it for angles.

    Gates are never grind — every one dies to a single good hit.

    Systems (catch the falling pods)

    • ◆ PLASMA — balls pierce breakable bricks and ignore gates (not steel), for 10s.
    • ⁂ SPLIT — up to 6 balls at once.
    • ⚡ CHAIN — each brick you break zaps its neighbours.
    • ↔ WIDE — bigger paddle. ◐ SLOW — capped ball speed. + EXTRA BALL — one more life.

    Controls

    • Mouse — move to steer, click to launch.
    • Keyboard — ←→ or A/D, ↑↓ or W/S to lift. Space launches · pauses. P pause · M mute · H help.
    • Touch, stick mode — drag the thumb pad below the arena, or touch the LEFT half of the arena. Push up while striking to smash through.
    • Touch, drag mode — start on the RIGHT half and drag anywhere; the paddle follows your finger. Enable Thumbstick to use stick controls across the whole arena.

    Gamepad — left stick moves and lifts. A launches / continues. Start pauses.

    Scoring

    Standard 50 · Gates 150 · all × your tier multiplier. Clearing a sector pays a bonus scaled by the multiplier you kept.
